proposals.summary: Add a bounded Old Main queue-relief hold for r3/r1 and a short Central hold for r2 when a train is arriving with transfers, keeping 2/2/2 and the terminal headway hold.
proposals.rationale: Findings 1-3 show large left-behind queues at Old Main (r3 peak 229, r1 peak 80) and Central (r2 peak 59) during stadium_exit; these are caused by buses departing just before heavy demand arrives. A short, bounded hold at these stops when the queue is large or a train with transfers is imminent should consolidate riders onto the current bus instead of making them wait a full headway. The hold is capped by maxHoldS and the 180 s per-loop budget, so it cannot create long gaps or violate minimum service. Changes: Add rule old-main-relief: hold 20 s at Old Main for r1/r3 when queue_here >= 15 and headway_behind_s >= 120; Add rule central-train-hold: hold 20 s at Central for r2 when train_eta_s <= 45 and expected_transfers >= 8; Keep allocation 2/2/2, maxHoldS 60, train dwell 45 s, and the existing even-headway terminal rule.

proposals.summary: Keep 2/2/2 and the terminal headway hold, but add a train-connection hold at rail-paired stops and a short Old Main queue-relief hold for r1/r3.
proposals.rationale: The champion misses 633 connections and leaves huge queues at Old Main (r3/r1) and Central (r2) during stadium_exit. A bounded hold at rail-paired stops when a train is arriving with transfers should recover the 94 Central riders who just missed r2 and similar misses, while a short Old Main relief hold lets the backlogged r1/r3 buses clear the 232+93 left-behind riders. Both holds are capped by maxHoldS and the 180 s per-loop budget, so no stop can go unserved for long. Changes: Add a train-connection hold at rail-paired stops when a train arrives soon with expected transfers and the next bus is far enough away; Add a short Old Main queue-relief hold for r1/r3 when the local queue is large and the following bus is not imminent; Raise maxHoldS from 60 to 75 to allow the connection hold without changing allocation or defaults.

proposals.summary: Add station-stop hold-for-train rules for r1/r2 and a bounded r3 queue-relief hold at Old Main, raising maxHold to 75 s while keeping 2/2/2 and the terminal headway hold.
proposals.rationale: The champion's worst losses are connection misses and queue buildup: 94 riders reached Central from the train just after r2 left, and Old Main/Stadium Station queues for r3 peaked near 230 and 65. A modest, bounded station hold (using the existing train_eta_s and expected_transfers features) lets r1/r2 absorb train alighting passengers without long dwell, and a short r3 Old Main hold prevents the 232-left-behind backlog. Because holds are capped by a new 75 s max and fire only on narrow conditions, bunching and downstream delay stay limited. Changes: Add rule train-feed-central: hold r2 bus at Central up to 60 s when a train is within 45 s and expected_transfers >= 8; Add rule oldmain-relief-r3: hold r3 at Old Main up to 55 s when queue_here >= 25 and headway_behind_s >= 240; Raise params.maxHoldS from 60 to 75 to give the bounded holds room while keeping all other params at 2/2/2 and 45 s train dwell.
